decisions.statement: Every condition is lowered or the whole narrow is refused.
No condition is dropped for being a condition this module cannot have.
A dropped condition would reach pages the caller never named.
A value that is no text is lowered as its text.
A lowered value becomes a test carrying text.
One key has one test of each name.
Two tests of different names on one key are carried together.

definition: a write's `where` lowered into the tests the service runs, or refused
